shortDescription: VIETJET AVIATION JOINT STOCK COMPANY HOSE:VJC  SAYS:

children: SIGNS AGREEMENT WITH STARLINK TO BRING HIGH-SPEED INTERNET TO FLIGHTS ACROSS ITS GLOBAL NETWORK
STARLINK WILL INITIALLY BE ROLLED OUT ACROSS 120 VIETJET AIRCRAFT, WITH DEPLOYMENT PLANNED ACROSS THE AIRLINE’S FUTURE FLEET
THE 120 AIRCRAFT INCLUDE 100 AIRBUS A321 OR BOEING 737 JETS AND 20 AIRBUS A330 AIRCRAFT
